reference_only_not_ported.why: The concrete IImageEncoder in mainline Jellyfin. SCOPE says NO native Skia — port the ImageEncoder semantics (probe/resize/overlay/encode/collage/trickplay/blurhash) onto the `image` crate instead. SkiaEncoder.cs (SkiaEncoder/StripCollageBuilder/SplashscreenBuilder/PercentPlayedDrawer/UnplayedCountIndicator/SkiaHelper) is the behavioural oracle for what each method must produce, NOT a file-for-file port target.

source.tests: NONE — Jellyfin.Drawing has no xUnit project. Parity is established by round-trips (dimension probe → resize math → re-probe) plus the already-ported DrawingUtils/ImageFormat unit tests in hermit-model. No InlineData oracle exists.

summary.purpose: Concrete image-processing layer: the `ImageProcessor` service (dimension probing, blurhash sizing, MD5 cache tags, on-the-fly resize/overlay/re-encode with a resized-image disk cache, collage dispatch) driving an `ImageEncoder` codec seam, plus a `NullImageEncoder` fallback and an `image`-crate-backed encoder. Emby.Photos.PhotoProvider reads EXIF/photo metadata off image files and back-fills dimensions via the processor.
summary.traits_already_defined: hermit-traits::drawing exports the `ImageProcessor` and `ImageEncoder` traits (async, object-safe) and the `ProcessedImage` return struct. hermit-traits::options exports `ImageProcessingOptions` (with has_default_options ported), `ImageCollageOptions`, `ItemImageInfo`. This crate IMPLEMENTS those traits — it does NOT redefine them.
summary.model_already_ported: hermit-model::drawing has ImageDimensions, ImageFormat (mime_type/extension/TryFrom<i32>), ImageOrientation, ImageResolution, drawing_utils::{resize, resize_fill} (banker's-rounding, unit-tested). hermit-model::net::mime_types has get_mime_type/get_mime_type_or. hermit-common::extensions::md5::compute gives raw MD5 bytes.
summary.portability: Mixed. The ImageProcessor orchestration (format selection, cache-path string building, has_default_options gating, blurhash component math, cache tags) is pure and fully portable. The ImageEncoder pixel work (decode/resize/encode/format-convert/crop-fill) ports onto the `image` crate. Skia-specific richness (SVG rasterization, RAW/ASTC/KTX decode, emoji/CJK typeface fallback, convolution-sharpen resize kernel, blur/percent-played/unplayed-count overlays, splashscreen) is heavyweight and is DEFERRED per scope. Blurhash is explicitly optional and DEFERRED. EXIF metadata (PhotoProvider) needs a Rust EXIF reader (kamadak-exif) in place of TagLib#.

symbols: ServiceError (error return; already has Backend/InvalidInput/NotFound variants that cover the C# ArgumentException/FileNotFound/InvalidData throws)
hermit-traits.note: The seam is ALREADY carved. hermit-drawing is a Wave-5 impl crate that fills these traits.

symbols: drawing::drawing_utils::{resize, resize_fill} (== C# DrawingUtils; used to reproduce ImageHelper.GetNewImageSize)

hermit-common.needed_for: GetImageCacheTag = MD5(baseItemPath + dateModified.Ticks).ToString("N"). hermit-common::extensions::md5::compute returns the raw 16 bytes; format as lowercase hex (no dashes) for the "N" spec.
hermit-common.port_strategy: ADD hermit-common as a dependency (it is the canonical MD5 home in this workspace — do NOT re-implement MD5 or pull an external md5 crate). If a Wave-ordering constraint forbids depending on hermit-common here, fall back to hermit-util for a hex helper, but prefer hermit-common.

image.port_strategy: The encoder backend. image::ImageReader::open(path).into_dimensions() for GetImageSize; DynamicImage::resize_exact / resize_to_fill for the resize math; image::imageops for collage compositing (overlay onto an RgbaImage canvas); ImageFormat + save_with_format/write_to for output. gif/bmp/ico/tiff/avif output would need extra `image` features — enable only what SupportedOutputFormats promises (webp/jpg/png; svg/gif deferred).

kamadak-exif.actually_used: only if PhotoProvider EXIF is ported (Unit 4)
kamadak-exif.port_strategy: Rust replacement for TagLib# EXIF reading (aperture/shutter/make/model/orientation/GPS/ISO/date-taken/rating/keywords). Add `exif = kamadak-exif` when Unit 4 is scheduled; keep behind a feature or defer if it bloats the wave. Not needed for Units 1–3.

chrono.needed_for: DateTime<Utc> flows through ProcessedImage / ImageProcessingOptions / ItemImageInfo and the cache-tag Ticks. ADD chrono (workspace) — the traits already expose chrono types.

async-trait.needed_for: Both traits are #[async_trait]; impls need it.

concrete_impls.name: NullImageEncoder
concrete_impls.note: Trivial fallback: supports_image_encoding=false, supports_image_collage_creation=false, input {png,jpeg,jpg}, output {Jpg,Png}, every real method returns Err(ServiceError::Backend("not implemented")) (== C# NotImplementedException). Port FIRST — it is the smallest complete ImageEncoder and lets ImageProcessor be exercised end-to-end.

concrete_impls.name: ImageCrateEncoder (new; == role of SkiaEncoder)
concrete_impls.note: The real encoder, on the `image` crate. supports_image_encoding=true. get_image_size via image dimensions probe (return ImageDimensions::default on zero-byte/undecodable, matching Skia's `default`). encode_image: decode → has_default_options short-circuit → resize (DrawingUtils.Resize then ResizeFill via hermit-model) → write output format at quality. Overlays (background_color/foreground_layer/blur/indicators), SVG, RAW, splashscreen: DEFERRED (see deferred_types).

concrete_impls.name: ImageProcessor (struct, holds Arc<dyn ImageEncoder> + config paths)
concrete_impls.note: Faithful orchestration port. supported_input_formats = the 25-entry set from ImageProcessor.cs (tiff..avif). supported_image_output_formats delegates to encoder. get_image_dimensions delegates to encoder.get_image_size. get_image_blur_hash computes xComp/yComp (sqrt(16*w/h) math) then delegates. get_image_cache_tag = MD5(path+Ticks) hex-N. process_image = the full pipeline (GetSupportedImage tbn passthrough, transparency detection, autoOrient for Photo, has_default_options gate, GetOutputFormat webp/png/jpg preference, GetCacheFilePath StringBuilder, resized-images disk cache, encoder.encode_image, error-fallback to original). create_image_collage delegates. The C# ParallelImageEncodingLimit AsyncNonKeyedLocker (semaphore = config value or ProcessorCount) is a concurrency limiter — see magic-number note; port as a tokio::Semaphore or DEFER the limiter (single-flight is correct, just unbounded).

PhotoProvider.role: ICustomMetadataProvider<Photo> — reads EXIF via TagLib# and back-fills Photo fields (aperture, shutter, make/model, width/height, rating, comment/overview, title→name, date-taken→DateCreated/PremiereDate/ProductionYear, genres, keywords→tags, software, orientation, exposure/focal, lat/long/alt, ISO), then falls back to imageProcessor.GetImageDimensions when width/height still 0.
PhotoProvider.port_strategy: Port the dimension-backfill path (uses ImageProcessor, trivial) in-scope. The EXIF field extraction requires kamadak-exif in place of TagLib# and touches the Photo domain entity + provider traits (ICustomMetadataProvider / IHasItemChangeMonitor) which live in hermit-traits::providers. Port the EXIF read as Unit 4 IF the Photo entity + provider trait are available; otherwise DEFER the metadata mapping and keep only dimension backfill.

ordered_port_plan.name: NullImageEncoder + encoder scaffolding
contents: Add deps: chrono (workspace) to Cargo.toml; keep hermit-traits/hermit-model/async-trait/image/thiserror.

src/null_encoder.rs: NullImageEncoder implementing ImageEncoder — supported_input_formats={png,jpeg,jpg}, supported_output_formats={Jpg,Png}, name="Null Image Encoder", supports_image_collage_creation=false, supports_image_encoding=false; get_image_size/encode_image/create_image_collage/create_splashscreen/create_trickplay_tile/get_image_blur_hash all Err(ServiceError::Backend(...)) (== NotImplementedException).
Round-trip test: the Null encoder advertises the right format sets and errors on real work.
ordered_port_plan.notes: Port of NullImageEncoder.cs. Smallest complete trait impl; establishes the module layout and lets Unit 3 be tested against a no-op backend.

ordered_port_plan.name: ImageCrateEncoder — probe + resize + format-convert on the `image` crate
contents: src/image_encoder.rs: ImageCrateEncoder. supported_input_formats = Skia's set intersected with what `image` can actually decode (jpeg/jpg/png/webp/gif/bmp/ico/tiff; RAW/ASTC/KTX/SVG DEFERRED). supported_output_formats = {Webp, Jpg, Png} (svg deferred). name="Image". supports_image_encoding=true.

get_image_size: probe dimensions with image::ImageReader::open(path).into_dimensions(); return ImageDimensions::default() for zero-byte / undecodable (mirrors Skia returning `default`), NotFound/Backend on missing file.

encode_image core pipeline: reject unsupported input ext (return input_path, like Skia); decode; build originalImageSize; has_default_options(input, size) && !auto_orient short-circuit returns input_path; compute new size via hermit-model drawing_utils::resize then resize_fill (== ImageHelper.GetNewImageSize); DynamicImage::resize_exact to (w,h); create output dir; write output format at quality (jpeg quality honored; png/webp best-effort). Return output_path.

create_image_collage: ratio-based dispatch (>=1.4 thumb strip, else square) compositing decoded+resized tiles onto an RgbaImage grid via image::imageops::overlay; port StripCollageBuilder square/thumb geometry WITHOUT text/gradient extras (DEFER library-name text + backdrop blur).

create_trickplay_tile: port CreateTrickplayTile grid packing (imgWidth×tileWidth by imgHeight×tileHeight, JPEG output at quality, validate counts/dims, default imgHeight from first image); pure geometry, ports cleanly.
create_splashscreen + get_image_blur_hash: return Err(Backend) here (DEFERRED features); wire real impls only if Unit 5 lands.

Round-trip tests: probe a fixture PNG/JPEG → known dims; resize 1920x1080 → maxWidth 960 → assert 960x540 (uses the ported DrawingUtils math); format-convert PNG→JPEG writes a decodable JPEG of the target size; trickplay tile packs N images into the grid.
ordered_port_plan.notes: The real codec backend. Semantic oracle = SkiaEncoder.EncodeImage/CreateImageCollage/CreateTrickplayTile. Skia's convolution-sharpen resize kernel and Mitchell/linear sampling are quality niceties, NOT pixel-exact contracts — use `image`'s Lanczos3/Triangle; parity is dimensional + decodable-output, not byte-identical.

ordered_port_plan.name: ImageProcessor — orchestration, cache tags, resized-image cache
contents: Add dep: hermit-common (for MD5) — see real_cross_project_deps.
src/processor.rs: ImageProcessor { encoder: Arc<dyn ImageEncoder>, image_cache_path: PathBuf } (config-supplied). Port ImageProcessor.cs.

supported_input_formats: the 25-entry set (tiff,tif,jpeg,jpg,png,cr2,crw,nef,orf,pef,arw,webp,gif,bmp,erf,raf,rw2,nrw,dng,ico,astc,ktx,pkm,wbmp,avif). supports_image_collage_creation / supported_image_output_formats delegate to encoder.

get_image_dimensions(path) → encoder.get_image_size. get_item_image_dimensions → use info.width/height if >0 else probe (C# also writes back onto the ItemImageInfo row; here return the dims — no mutable item tree).

get_image_blur_hash / _sized: port the xCompF=sqrt(16*w/h), yCompF, min(x+1,9) component math, then delegate to encoder.get_image_blur_hash (which is DEFERRED → surfaces as Backend error until Unit 5).

get_image_cache_tag_for_path(path, dateModified) = hex_N(md5(path + dateModified.Ticks)) — reproduce .NET DateTime.Ticks (100ns since 0001-01-01) from chrono; lowercase hex no dashes. get_image_cache_tag(item_id, info) folds onto the path+dateModified form (ChapterInfo/User overloads collapsed — see trait doc).

process_image: full port — GetSupportedImage (tbn passthrough), SupportsImageEncoding gate, File.Exists / gif passthrough, transparency-type detection ({.png,.webp,.gif,.svg}), autoOrient Photo branch (needs item kind; without the OOP item tree, drive from options/ItemImageInfo — DEFER Photo-orientation autoOrient if the Photo entity isn't wired, defaulting autoOrient=false), has_default_options gate, GetOutputFormat (webp>png-if-transparent>first-mutual>jpg), GetCacheFilePath StringBuilder (quality,datemodified=Ticks,f=format,width,height,maxwidth,maxheight,fillwidth,fillheight,p=,blur,b=,fl=,v=Version '3'), GetCachePath (md5 of the key + ext, first-char prefix dir under image_cache_path/resized-images), skip-if-cached, encoder.encode_image, resultPath==original short-circuit, error → return original + mime + dateModified.
create_image_collage → encoder.create_image_collage.

Round-trip tests: cache-tag is a stable 32-char lowercase hex; identical key → identical cache file path; changing any option (width/quality/format/blur) changes the key; process_image with default options + supported format returns the original path unmodified; process_image with a resize produces a cached file and re-invocation hits the cache.
ordered_port_plan.notes: The heart of the port. Pure string/hash/gating logic on top of Units 1–2. The C# `Version='3'` cache-buster and the JPEG-quality 90 default-threshold (already a named const in options) are magic numbers to surface as settings.

ordered_port_plan.name: PhotoProvider — dimension backfill (+ EXIF metadata, conditional)
contents: src/photo_provider.rs: PhotoProvider { processor: Arc<dyn ImageProcessor> }. Port PhotoProvider.cs.

IN-SCOPE (always): SetImagePath(Primary, path) + the width/height<=0 backfill path that calls processor.get_item_image_dimensions and writes dims back; HasChanged (last-write-time compare); Name="Embedded Information".

CONDITIONAL (EXIF): if the Photo domain entity + provider traits are available in hermit-traits/hermit-model, add kamadak-exif and map aperture/shutter/make/model/rating/comment/title/date-taken/genres/keywords/software/orientation/exposure/focal/lat-long-alt/ISO onto the Photo. include-extensions gate = {jpg,jpeg,png,tiff,cr2,webp,avif}. If the Photo entity/provider trait is NOT yet ported, DEFER the EXIF mapping and ship only the dimension-backfill + change-monitor.
Round-trip tests: a Photo with width=0 gets dimensions filled from the processor; extension gate excludes non-photo files; (if EXIF ported) a fixture JPEG with known EXIF yields the mapped fields.
ordered_port_plan.notes: Port of Emby.Photos.PhotoProvider. Split into always-on (dimensions) and conditional (EXIF) so the unit lands even if the Photo entity/provider trait lags. TagLib# → kamadak-exif is the one genuinely new external dep.

deferred_types.name: AssemblyInfo (both projects)
deferred_types.reason: .NET assembly attribute plumbing — no Rust analogue.

deferred_types.name: Blurhash (GetImageBlurHash real impl)
deferred_types.reason: SCOPE marks blurhash optional/defer-if-heavy. The component math (xComp/yComp) is ported in ImageProcessor, but the actual DCT encode (BlurHashSharp) is deferred; encoder.get_image_blur_hash returns a Backend error / empty string. Add `blurhash` crate in a later wave if wanted.

deferred_types.name: SVG rasterization (SkiaEncoder GetBitmapFromSvg / GetImageSize svg branch / ImageFormat::Svg output)
deferred_types.reason: Needs resvg/usvg (native-ish). Scope says image-crate only; SVG input/output deferred. supported_output_formats omits Svg.

deferred_types.name: RAW / ASTC / KTX / PKM / WBMP decode
deferred_types.reason: SupportedInputFormats advertises them (matching Jellyfin) but `image` cannot decode RAW/ASTC/KTX. Advertise-but-fail (return original / Backend) as Skia effectively does on unsupported; real decode deferred.

deferred_types.name: Overlay drawing: blur, ForegroundLayer opacity, BackgroundColor, UnplayedCountIndicator, PercentPlayedDrawer
deferred_types.reason: SkiaEncoder canvas-composite features (StripCollageBuilder text, UnplayedCountIndicator.cs, PercentPlayedDrawer.cs). Heavy 2D-canvas work with no `image`-crate equivalent for text/rounded badges; the resize/format core covers the common path. encode_image should honor them if trivially expressible via imageops, else ignore-with-log (Skia also try/catches indicator drawing).

deferred_types.name: CreateSplashscreen / SplashscreenBuilder
deferred_types.reason: Poster+backdrop montage with gradients/text; cosmetic, not on the image-serving hot path. Deferred.

deferred_types.name: Emoji/CJK typeface fallback (InitializeTypefaces/GetFontForCharacter)
deferred_types.reason: Only used by collage/splashscreen text drawing, which is deferred. No font stack needed for resize/probe/convert.

deferred_types.name: Convolution-sharpen resize kernel + Mitchell/linear SKSamplingOptions
deferred_types.reason: Skia quality tuning; `image`'s Lanczos3/Triangle filters substitute. Not a byte-exact parity contract (no test oracle), so the exact kernel is deferred.

deferred_types.name: NormalizePath diacritics/OtherLetter temp-copy hack
deferred_types.reason: SkiaSharp-specific workaround for native path handling; the `image` crate opens UTF-8 paths directly. Not needed.

deferred_types.name: AsyncNonKeyedLocker parallel-encoding limiter
deferred_types.reason: Concurrency cap (semaphore = ParallelImageEncodingLimit or ProcessorCount). Correctness holds without it (just unbounded parallelism). Port as tokio::Semaphore or defer; surface the limit as a setting.

deferred_types.name: PhotoProvider EXIF field mapping
deferred_types.reason: CONDITIONALLY deferred (Unit 4): needs kamadak-exif + the Photo domain entity + ICustomMetadataProvider provider trait to be ported. Dimension-backfill path is in-scope regardless.

test_fixtures_parity_oracle.detail: Jellyfin.Drawing / Emby.Photos have no test project. There is no InlineData oracle to transliterate. Parity is enforced by (a) the ALREADY-PORTED unit tests on hermit-model DrawingUtils::{resize,resize_fill} and ImageFormat (the resize-math oracle), (b) the ImageProcessingOptions::has_default_options tests already in hermit-traits, and (c) new round-trip tests in hermit-drawing: probe→resize→re-probe dimension equality, format-convert produces a decodable image of the target size, MD5 cache-tag stability/sensitivity, cache hit/miss, and default-options passthrough.
round_trip_tests_to_author: probe fixture PNG/JPEG returns known ImageDimensions
resize_fill box → clamps to source when smaller
PNG→JPEG / PNG→WEBP convert → output decodes at target dims
trickplay tile packs N images into an imgW*tileW x imgH*tileH grid, returns imgHeight
cache tag = 32-char lowercase hex, stable for same (path,ticks), differs when either changes
GetCacheFilePath key changes when any option changes; same key → same file path (first-char prefix dir)
process_image default-options+supported-format returns original path & mime unchanged
process_image resize writes to resized-images cache; second call is a cache hit
NullImageEncoder advertises {png,jpeg,jpg}/{Jpg,Png} and errors on encode/probe/collage
PhotoProvider backfills width/height from the processor when the ItemImageInfo row has 0x0

external_crates_needed: image (0.25, workspace pin; may need extra features: gif/tiff/bmp/ico for input, none new for {webp,jpg,png} output)
chrono (workspace; DateTime<Utc> + .NET Ticks for cache tags)
hermit-common (MD5 for cache tags — add to Cargo.toml)
kamadak-exif (ONLY if PhotoProvider EXIF is ported in Unit 4; else omit)

magic_numbers_to_surface_as_settings.controls: resized-image cache-buster; bump to invalidate all cached renders

magic_numbers_to_surface_as_settings.value: blurhash tile cap 16 and component clamp 9
magic_numbers_to_surface_as_settings.suggest: if blurhash ever un-deferred, expose as settings

magic_numbers_to_surface_as_settings.controls: already a named const DEFAULT_QUALITY_THRESHOLD in hermit-traits options — flag to user as a candidate setting

note_no_runtime_machinery_exceptions: Unlike hermit-naming, this crate DOES do real I/O (file reads/writes, directory creation, a disk cache) and pixel work via `image`. The traits are already async in hermit-traits, so impls are async. No DI container; the encoder is injected as Arc<dyn ImageEncoder> and cache paths/config are constructor args.
